item.text: I found two validation bugs: zero is accepted, and the release limit uses on-hand stock instead of reserved stock. Together, these can produce a `KeyError` or a negative reservation. I’ll fix both and add coverage for the error cases and successful releases.

+def test_release_returns_reserved_stock_to_available():
+    inv = Inventory()
+    inv.receive("A", 10)
+    inv.reserve("A", 4)
+    inv.release("A", 2)
+    assert (inv.on_hand("A"), inv.reserved("A"), inv.available("A")) == (10, 2, 8)
+    inv.release("A", 2)
+    assert (inv.on_hand("A"), inv.reserved("A"), inv.available("A")) == (10, 0, 10)
